title: Visiting the Hadzabe: What to Consider
excerpt: The Hadzabe near Lake Eyasi are one of the last hunter-gatherer communities in Africa. Should you visit, and how?
body:
## Who are the Hadzabe?

The Hadzabe live around Lake Eyasi. A part of the community still lives largely by hunting and gathering. Their language uses click sounds.

## Tourism

Tourism brings income, but also pressure. Some visits feel like a show.

## Questions to ask

- Does the community decide on visits?
- How much of the fee goes to the community?
- Is the group small?
- Is there a respectful guide who speaks the language?

## During a visit

- Follow the guide.
- Ask before taking photos.
- Do not give alcohol or sweets.

## Land rights

Land loss is a serious threat. Some organisations help secure land rights.

## Your choice

You can also choose not to visit. Both are valid choices.

See [Lake Eyasi](/blog/lake-eyasi-guide/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
